simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to תֹּפֶת (H8612) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-loc.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 9 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: תֹּפֶת (Tôpheth) means Topheth , a place near Jerusalem First listed occurrence: 2Kgs 23 10.

definitions.full: H8612. Topheth II. תֹּ֫פֶת proper name, of a location in valley of בֶּןתִֿנֹּם , south of Jerusalem (etymology doubtful, see GFM Ency. Bib. MOLECH ; RS Semitic i. 357, 2nd ed. 372, 377 and others think Aramaic, = fire-place , compare שׁפת ); — with article ׳הַתּ 2Kin 23:10 5 t., article omitted Jer 7:32 ; 19:11-12 , — place of sacrificing children 7:31 , compare 7:32 a 19:6 (compare 19:5 ), 2Kin 23:10 ; to become burial-place Jer 7:32 b 19:11 ; in simile of desecrated city 19:12 ; 19:13 ( הַתּ ׳מְקוֺם ); scene of a prophecy of Jeremiah, 19:14 ; — Ταφες , Ταφεθ (compare Lag BN 78 ), ᵐ5 L 2Kin 23:10 Θαφφεθ . — See GFM l.c. Salmond Hast.DB TOPHET .
